prompt: Basic ring-opening: same 2-methyl-1,2-epoxypropane as before, but with NaOMe / MeOH. Draw the product.

traps.note: Under base, SN2-like steric control sends the Nu to the LESS substituted (primary) C.

explanation: Under base, there's no cation; the Nu does SN2-like backside attack on the LESS hindered epoxide carbon (primary CH2 here). The methoxy ends up on the terminal CH2 and OH stays on the originally more substituted C.
